subject.title: fix: generated image previews return unauthorized

question: Should session-bound managed-image bytes returned by `artifacts.download` remain available to `operator.read` clients after transcript and coordinate validation, or require `operator.admin`?
rationale: This is an intentional Gateway authorization contract change; source and tests can verify enforcement, but they cannot choose the acceptable trust boundary for existing paired read-scoped clients.

options.title: Confirm `operator.read`
options.body: Keep the proposed read-scoped RPC path, retain owner/admin-only direct HTTP, and require exact-head allowed and denied proof before merge.

options.title: Require `operator.admin`
options.body: Change the artifact-RPC path and user-facing recovery behavior to require admin scope, then update protocol wording, tests, and proof together.

recommendation.title: Confirm `operator.read`
recommendation.body: Keep the proposed read-scoped RPC path, retain owner/admin-only direct HTTP, and require exact-head allowed and denied proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They were specifically asked to confirm the permanent Gateway authorization contract in the PR discussion.
